records.issue_text: [High/security] ClientPermissionsV2.java:79 — canView(client) immediately accepts an all-clients VIEW grant before evaluating the target client’s permissions, bypassing client-specific denials.
records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a potential authorization bypass in ClientPermissionsV2.canView(ClientModel client) at line 79. The method first checks `canView()` which returns true if the user has global VIEW permission (line 85: `return canViewClientDefault() || hasPermission(AdminPermissionsSchema.VIEW)`). If this returns true, the method short-circuits and returns true without checking client-specific permissions.
